children: Britain appointed Canada's chief statistician André Loranger as its new national statistician on Tuesday, tasking him with leading the country's statistical system and advising the government on statistical matters.
Loranger will serve a term of five years and take up his role as the head of the UK Statistics Authority this autumn.
